summary: Default aspect orb profiles for natal, transit, synastry, and composite interpretation.
body: Orbs control whether an aspect is active enough to read. Use wider allowances for natal patterns, tighter allowances for daily transits, and strict settings for midpoint-based composite charts.
definition: An orb is the permitted distance from exactness for an aspect to count as active.
appUsage: Use transit orbs for daily check-ins and notification logic.
Use natal or synastry profiles for birth-chart and relationship analysis.
Treat exact or near-exact aspects as louder than wide aspects even when both are valid.
note: Imported from the project policy bundle; source file was not copied into the repo.

natal.note: Add the larger body modifier when a luminary is one of the two bodies.

transit.note: Tight orbs for daily weather. For the check-in's 'tightest orb' pick, rank by exact distance regardless of cap; ~1 degree is a strong daily hit. The Moon moves ~13 deg/day, so lunar transits stay in orb for hours, not days.

orbs.rule: effectiveOrb = profile orb for the aspect (+ body modifier under the natal profile). A contact counts when |separation - aspectAngle| <= effectiveOrb. Rank candidates by |separation - aspectAngle| ascending.
